tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Returns the connected Polidict account's ID, name, nickname and email.

tools.name: get_learning_context
tools.description: Returns an account overview: the learner's languages, named word groups, a practice progress summary and the practice skills available, plus the current plan and remaining word and group capacity across all languages. It lists no individual words; find_my_words searches saved words and get_training_

tools.name: lookup_dictionary_word
tools.description: Looks up a word in Polidict's public dictionary and returns meanings, translations and examples. It reads only the public catalog, never the learner's saved words, and changes nothing. A miss returns no entries.

tools.name: find_my_words
tools.description: Searches or browses the learner's saved words by text or group to read or edit them, with meanings, examples, notes, images, group membership, IDs and versions for save_word and delete_word. tools.name: save_word
tools.description: Creates a word, or updates an existing word when itemId and expectedVersion are both provided. Matching text alone never updates an existing word. Updates are patches: omitted fields stay unchanged and null clears supported fields. definitions edits a meaning by ID or adds one without an ID; removeD

tools.name: delete_word
tools.description: Permanently deletes one saved word with its meanings, examples, group memberships and practice progress. Requires the word's latest version from find_my_words or save_word; a stale version returns WORD_CHANGED without deleting. requestId makes retries idempotent.

tools.name: find_my_groups
tools.description: Finds the learner's word groups by name, or browses them, with IDs, versions and descriptions. Results are paged; pass nextCursor to continue. A group's words are listed by find_my_words with its group ID.

tools.name: create_group
tools.description: Creates a private word group with a name and optional description. requestId makes retries idempotent. Words join a group through save_word's addGroupIds. Subject to the plan's group limit.

tools.name: update_group
tools.description: Renames a word group or changes its description; null clears the description. Requires the group's latest version. Sharing settings and the group image are preserved. requestId makes retries idempotent.

tools.name: delete_group
tools.description: Deletes one word group. Its words stay saved and only their membership in this group is removed. Requires the group's latest version. requestId makes retries idempotent.

tools.name: get_word_progress
tools.description: Returns progress for one saved word. The overall level (new, learning, learned or mastered; inbox when the word has no meanings) comes from its weakest meaning or skill; learned requires every meaning plus writing, listening and speaking to be in regular reviews. tools.name: search_word_images
tools.description: Searches stock photo providers for images that illustrate a saved word, using a short English query, and returns choices with photographer and source credits. Searching never changes the word's saved image; save_word with imageUrl sets one. Images are searched, never generated.

tools.name: get_training_items
tools.description: Picks a batch of the learner's saved words to practise now, ten by default, for the meaning, writing, listening or speaking skills, ordered by the practice schedule. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_profile, get_word_progress, get_training_items · Private data: create_group, submit_training_results · Public sink: get_profile, submit_training_results · Destructive: delete_word, delete_group.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_profile, get_word_progress, get_training_items · Private data: create_group, submit_training_results · Public sink: get_profile, submit_training_results · Destructive: delete_word, delete_group

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
